# Plain ifs only (Claude files/35).

# The jury line of a blueprint of a Primary Technology ($DA_Punk$): off the design's path, it is jury-rigged.
DA_GB_jury_part = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			DA_GB_jury_rigger = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_Unique_mod.PUNK.Flag.$DA_unit$.$DA_Punk$ }
		}
		DA_GB_jury_apply = { DA_unit = $DA_unit$ DA_Cost = $DA_Cost$ DA_RUNE_SLOTS = $DA_RUNE_SLOTS$ }
	}
}
# The jury line of an ordinary blueprint: jury-rigged in a design whose Primary Technology refuses ordinary blueprints.
DA_GB_jury_normal = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			DA_GB_jury_rigger = yes
			has_country_flag = DA_disable_normal_BPs.$DA_unit$
		}
		DA_GB_jury_apply = { DA_unit = $DA_unit$ DA_Cost = $DA_Cost$ DA_RUNE_SLOTS = $DA_RUNE_SLOTS$ }
	}
}
# 2 points cheaper (a blueprint of 2 keeps 1), 1 rune slot less, and the fixed effect Jury-Rigged Parts at the finish.
DA_GB_jury_apply = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_GB_jury_rigged_tt
	set_country_flag = DA_Unique_mod.BLUEPRINT.Flag.$DA_unit$.GB_shoddy
	tooltip = {
		add_country_modifier = {
			name = DA_Unique_mod.BLUEPRINT.$DA_unit$.GB_shoddy
			duration = -1
		}
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_bp_cost value = $DA_Cost$ }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_bp_cost value = 3 } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_Cost_$DA_unit$ value = -2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_bp_cost value = 2 } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_Cost_$DA_unit$ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_bp_slots value = $DA_RUNE_SLOTS$ }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_bp_slots value = 1 } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_Runes_Slots_STAT_MAX_$DA_unit$ value = -1 }
		}
	}
}
